_note: Registry of frozen SCHEMA_MAP.md versions. Each entry pins the SHA256 of the file (LF-normalised bytes - see benchmarks.invariants.schema_map_sha256) at the moment the version was sealed. Any change to SCHEMA_MAP.md without bumping SCHEMA_MAP_VERSION and adding a new entry here fails CI (test_schema_map_sha_matches_registered_version) AND aborts any benchmark run (verify_schema_map_lock).
